requirement.requirement_text: 业务用户在 Telegram 中向机器人发送一条聊天消息提出问题，例如询问下一次活动的时间、下个月有多少场活动、谁演讲的次数最多，或哪些未来活动还没有安排演讲者。系统收到发往该 Telegram 机器人的聊天消息后被触发，从 Google Sheets 中读取已排期的活动日程，将日程转换为表格化的文本形式，并据此交由语言模型处理用户在 Telegram 中提出的问题。语言模型给出的回答被回传到同一个 Telegram 会话中，作为对该用户的答复。

source_spans.text: Chat with your event schedule from Google Sheets in Telegram:

"When is the next meetup?"
"How many events are there next month?"
"Who presented most often?"
"Which future meetups have no presenters yet?"
This workflow lets you chat with a telegram bot about past, present and future events that are scheduled in a Google Spreadsheet.

Upon getting triggered by a chat message to a telegram bot, the schedule of meetups is retrieved from Google Spreadsheets, converted into a markdown table syntax and fed into the system prompt of an LLM (we're using OpenRouter in this example), whose output is posted back as answer into the same telegram chat.

inputs: 用户在 Telegram 中向机器人发送的聊天消息
Google Sheets 中维护的活动日程数据
conditions: 收到发往 Telegram 机器人的聊天消息时触发
allowed_actions: 从 Google Sheets 读取已排期的活动日程
将日程转换为表格化文本后交由语言模型处理用户问题
将语言模型的回答回传到同一个 Telegram 会话
visible_outcomes: 用户在同一 Telegram 会话中收到基于日程数据的自然语言答复
